resolution: Fixed PlayRoute crash 'ReferenceError: state is not defined' that killed the editor /test play view on mount. The liftedPieces useMemo (terrain-lift, req_0444 lineage) referenced groundColumnTop(state.world ...) and listed state.world in its deps, but 'state' only exists as a local const inside the streamState useMemo above it — out of scope here, so it threw at mount and GlobalErrorBoundary caught it. Repointed both the call and the dep to props.state.world (the component's GameState prop, line 349 'state: GameState'), matching how the other groundColumnTop call sites resolve the world. TSX hot-reloads (no rebuild). Verified no other out-of-scope 'state' tokens remain in PlayRoute. This unblocks the /test bisect for the doorway-collision question (req_0539).
